searchText: Are EL teams specifying a new field in their respective genesis.json files to configure `HISTORY_SERVE_WINDOW` for EIP-2935? Or is it being hardcoded like a preset? If not, can you tell us what the field is called in your genesis files? we hardcoded it, shall we make it configurable? Unsure tbh, maybe <@892053833121923094> has an opinion too? Our reasoning, if the window is 8192 then we can't test the case of requesting outside of the window until ~1.2d has passed - which is a very long test 😛 would be cool to have a similar concept of minimal preset but for EL values, (even if it requires an additional build, testing could be a lot quicker) not than many values to change on the EL side 😄 we can just handle it on the genesis-generator tool side of things I have yet to write a test with the 8192 blocks that are required, but in theory it should not be a problem because we can send the payloads as fast as possible and we don’t need to wait for 12 seconds on each, but I’ll try to run it today to see how long it takes ahhh, yeah we can't do that on the interop side of things. Best we can do is drop slot per seconds down, but then its still gonna take a few hours to finish. I think the interesting part is having 8192+ blocks before the fork, could we use a pre-built pre-fork chain here? Yeah we have local shadowforks working now, so it should be an easy test for us to handle 😄 we hardcoded it
